posts.name: metaphysician
posts.cooked:
After having played SotM for a few months now, and becoming a big fan, I've come to a conclusion:

I really, really hate Spite.

Note, I don't mean in the sense of finding him hard, or disliking his fluff.  Rather, playing against him is just aggressively unfun.  The first half of the game is almost always a waiting game for him to flip, given how much he regenerates.  The second half is boring, because there's no variation:  he always has the same drugs, and always does the same things, with no card play at all.  What's more, the "suffer damage every time you use a power" is just masochistic.  In almost every way, Spite feels like an experiment in how to design a villain that, ahem, spites the players for wanting to play the game.

Does anyone else have any villains they really, really hate playing against, for whatever reason?

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked: Spite, Matriarch, Chairman, Miss Information. With the first three it just feels very samey. Their cards come out and if you can break them then you’ll get hurt and they’ll probably just come back out again anyway regardless of (H) scaling or chance. Miss Information feels like she gets a head start while the heroes patiently wait for their cue to figure out that the reason they’re burning to death while standing stupidly in a burning building that their secretary lit the building on fire. It doesn’t feel terribly heroic, and I feel like it’s an old episode of The Superfriends. Corny and poorly paced.

Spite and Miss Information. I don't see this having anything to do with difficulty; they both force you to spend a fair amount of time waiting. If you're lucky, you have some deck manipulation and you can use this to draw them out a little faster, but generally you just have to wait.

I also get annoyed by Spite's drugs. On PL626, I can see taking damage for using powers, but the discarding gets old very fast. Then, in this single-target game, Mynd-Phyre takes out most environment effects, which could help to add some variability.

I like both of them conceptually; I just don't find the fights very engaging.

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I'm going to jump on the Miss Information and Spite bandwagon too.

I actually don't mind Miss Information very occasionally, but I certainly don't complain that we veto her in G+ games. Her games just feel very samey to me - sit around having her wreck your stuff being unable to do much until she finally flips (and that can take ages since it's entirely based on where the Clue cards are sitting in the deck) which is dull, and then actually being able to play the game afterwards.

And Spite. He's another one where you sit around not doing much until the right cards come out for him to flip, and then you can start actually playing. And when he does flip it's essentially the exact same game every time because he has the same five drugs, and he removes any variation you might have got from the environment. Boring. I'm with Matchstickman, a couple more drug cards so you need 5/7 would help a lot.
